meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform comprehensive exploratory data analysis on scientific data files across 200+ file formats. This skill should be used when analyzing any scientific data file to understand its structure, content, quality, and characteristics. Automatically detects file type and generates detailed markdown reports with format-specific analysis, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations. Covers chemistry, bioinformatics, microscopy, spectroscopy, proteomics, metabolomics, and general scientific data formats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析科学数据文件并生成详细报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解科学数据文件的结构和质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically analyze scientific data files and generate detailed reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and quality of scientific data files

howto.what: 当你提供科学数据文件路径后，它会自动检测文件类型，分析结构、质量和内容，并生成一份详细的 Markdown 报告，包含统计摘要和后续分析建议。
howto.when: 当你要求分析、探索或总结一个科学数据文件时触发，例如说“分析这个文件”或“帮我看看这个数据”。

say.text: 分析这个 FASTQ 文件，看看测序质量如何。
say.note: 触发对 FASTQ 格式的 EDA，生成质量报告。

say.text: 帮我探索一下这个 CSV 数据集的结构和缺失值。
say.note: 触发对表格数据的 EDA，输出统计和缺失值分析。

howto.what_en: When you provide a path to a scientific data file, it automatically detects the file type, analyzes structure, content, and quality, and generates a detailed Markdown report with statistical summaries and downstream analysis recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze, explore, or summarize a scientific data file, e.g., "Analyze this file" or "Help me look at this data."

say_en.text: Analyze this FASTQ file and check the sequencing quality.
say_en.note: Triggers EDA for FASTQ format, producing a quality report.

say_en.text: Explore this CSV dataset and show its structure and missing values.
say_en.note: Triggers EDA for tabular data, outputting statistics and missing value analysis.
